summary: @servicetitan/microfront-utils preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The preinstall script `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/) and uses `execFileSync` to run `math_init.js` under it at npm install time. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle using string-array/index-shuffle obfuscation (identifiers `_0x...`, a `WV8StW` rotation function, and a large opaque constant array `n7gIxM`) and is shipped at the tarball root while not being declared in `package.json`'s `files` list (which declares only `dist` and `src`). The package advertises itself as React/mobx microfrontend utilities and has no functional need for the Bun runtime or a `math_init` module. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern executes opaque, obfuscated code under a runtime the installer did not choose, on every default `npm install`, giving arbitrary code execution on the installer's host with no relationship to the declared package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
